label: has political leader or minister
definition: Political body, party, country or legislature 1 has or had person 2 as a leader, minister or senior political officeholder.
scope_notes: Direction body to leader, inverse of the dominant leader-of family. Legislature majority/minority leaders and whips qualify. Spokespeople, aides, visitors, merely cited officials elsewhere and the reverse direction do not.

facts.reason: The evidence identifies Abrams as a spokeswoman for the department. This is the wrong role and person-to-body direction for a body having a leader.
Senate leader and leader-in/of-Senate appositions explicitly name Daschle in the body-to-leader direction.
Israel possesses a minister and leader explicitly named Shimon Peres.
Yu Cho was born in Korea. This is a birth-location pair, not a political body naming its leader.
India has a minister explicitly named Atal Behari Vajpayee in possessive and minister-of-India appositions.
